notes:
More reliable sending: on some accounts LinkedIn shows the message window inside
an embedded area, where sending stopped as a safety measure. The app now types,
checks and sends directly in the right person's input field, regardless of the
layout, and confirms the text is there before sending. The chat window is also
closed more reliably afterwards, including names with titles.

More accurate targeting: messages are only created for contacts who could be a
customer for your offer. Competitors and unrelated industries are filtered out.
New in settings: minimum AI confidence (default 70 %).

Failed messages can now be copied with one click and sent manually.
